autoForceFocus: Take focus back after the delay
autoForceFocusHint: When off (default), a rule whose program is no longer in the foreground when the delay ends is skipped, so the hotkey can never land in another app. When on, Lume first tries to bring the program's window back to the foreground and then presses — best effort: Windows blocks background processes from stealing focus in some cases (e.g. an elevated window is in front), and the attempt is then logged and skipped.
autoUseAgentHint: Windows only delivers synthetic input to windows of the same or a lower privilege level (UIPI), so a program running as administrator never receives the shortcut otherwise. This routes the send through a small elevated helper that does nothing but press the key. Register it in System first; when it is off or missing, Lume presses in-process and says so in the log.
autoAgentResident: Keep the agent running after logon
autoAgentResidentHint: Off (default): the helper starts on demand and exits again after a minute idle, so no privileged process sits around. On: it stays resident (a few MB) and injections are instant.
autoTestNeedsAgent: {process} runs as administrator — enable the elevation agent to reach it
autoTestAgentUnavailable: The elevation agent is enabled but could not be started — register it in System
autoTestFocusMoved: The foreground moved away before the shortcut could be sent
autoHint: When one of these programs opens a new window and takes focus, Lume presses its shortcut once. Alt+Tabbing back to an already-running instance does not re-trigger.
autoPickEmpty: No programs with open windows were found
autoTestHint: Press this rule's shortcut right now — regardless of the new-window trigger and the delay — so it can be checked against an already-running program
autoTestNotRunning: No {process} window found — start the program first, then test
autoTestFocusFailed: Could not bring {process} to the foreground — test cancelled
autoTestInvalid: This shortcut cannot be sent, so it cannot be tested
autoDelayTitle: Trigger delay (ms) — how long to wait after the window takes focus before pressing
autoDelayHint: Trigger delay is per rule, in milliseconds (0 = press immediately, max 60000). If the foreground moves to another program during the delay, the hotkey is not sent.
autoNeedModifier: Include at least one modifier (Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win)
autoComboUnsupported: That key isn't supported (letters, digits, F1–F24, Space, arrows…)
autoNotice: Only fires when a new window of the program takes the foreground — background / minimized launches aren't covered.
clipEmptyHint: Copy anything and it will appear here
clipCopiedNoTarget: Copied — no target window to paste into
roundAppIconsHint: Off: show extracted icon artwork as-is. On: crop it to a circle.
hotkeyConflictLume: Conflicts with the other Lume shortcut
hotkeyTaken: Already in use by another program
settingsAgentHint: Only needed for auto actions whose target program runs as administrator. Registering asks for administrator rights once (a scheduled task with highest privileges); afterwards Windows starts the helper silently, and it can do nothing but send the configured shortcut to a foreground window.
indexEmpty: No index — enable one in Settings
placeholderHint: Leave empty to use the default text
clipIgnoreHint: Copies from these apps won't be recorded
settingsClipPreviewHint: Off = no preview window pops for selected entries (inline thumbnails stay)
clipDedupHint: When on, an identical copy refreshes the existing entry instead of adding a new row (whole-content match; images keep only the consecutive-repeat guard)
clipInvalid: This item's content is no longer available
rememberLastPageHint: Reopen on the last page (mode + category) after a restart too; within a session the launcher always resumes the last page and its on-screen state. Search text is never written to disk
perModeQueryHint: Off: every mode shares one search-box value — the latest input wins (session only, never written to disk). On: each mode remembers its own search text like before.
idleResetHint: When the launcher has been hidden longer than this, the next summon starts clean: home page, empty search, and a reset for every plugin page that is not exempt. Exempt plugin pages keep their query and state — set that per plugin in the Plugins page, or let the manifest declare it.
pluginKeepSessionHint: On: this mode keeps its query and page state when an idle reset happens. Off overrides a manifest that asked to keep it. No effect while idle reset is off.
settingsSaveFailed: Couldn't save settings — still open; check the log and try again
settingsUnsavedHint: This settings window has an unsaved draft. Save it before closing, or discard only that draft. Controls marked “Immediate effect” have already been applied and will not be rolled back.
settingsDiscardHint: Importing or restoring replaces the live settings. Your unsaved draft would be lost; changes marked “Immediate effect” stay applied.
pluginPermissionDenied: Plugin "{id}" did not declare the "{perm}" permission (plugin.toml: permissions = ["{perm}"])
pluginListEmpty: No items — the plugin returned an empty list
pluginsInstallReinstall: Version {old} is already installed; reinstalling it.
pluginsInstallDowngrade: Version {old} is installed; this package holds the older {new} — installing rolls the plugin back.
pluginsInstallSignatureValid: Signature verified (ed25519) — the package matches its publisher's key.
pluginsInstallUnsigned: Unsigned package · SHA-256 {sha256}… — verify it out of band if you care about its origin.
pluginUninstallHint: Uninstall and delete the plugin directory (including its private files); document-store data is kept.
permWindowDesc: Read foreground-window info and the current Explorer folder
pluginDescClipboard: Built-in clipboard manager page — history, categories, multi-select merge paste and the satellite preview.
pluginDescPreview: Built-in preview service — renders entry previews in the satellite window.
pluginApiMismatch: "{name}" needs plugin API {api}, but this build supports {host} — plugin disabled
pluginCircuitOpen: "{name}" keeps failing and was paused (other plugins are unaffected — reload it or save settings to retry)
pluginPermEnforcedHint: The plugin can only call the capabilities it declares; anything else is refused.
pluginsDevModeHint: Show the developer options (Reload, Trust all). 「Trust all」 only takes effect while this is on.
permClipboardDesc: Read and write the system clipboard
permNetworkDesc: Make HTTP requests via the host
permScreenDesc: Read cursor position and display geometry
permTrashDesc: Move files to the recycle bin
pluginsTrustAllHint: Skip capability checks for every disk plugin (development escape hatch; requires developer mode)
pluginWindowOpenFailed: Failed to open the plugin window: {id}
settingsOperationFailed: The operation failed. See the log for details.
settingsErrorPermission: Access denied. Check permissions and try again.
settingsErrorNotFound: The requested item could not be found.
settingsRestoreAppDefaultsHint: Resets appearance, navigation, clipboard, hotkey, search and automation settings only. Plugins and system integrations are not changed.
settingsHeightHint: The launcher can shrink to fit its content; this value is the maximum height.
settingsCustomHint: Keeps the current manual position; no preset is applied on first show.
settingsShowRecentHint: Turning this off hides the bar, but recent items are still recorded.
hotkeyReserved: That key is reserved by the launcher
hotkeyModeHint: A single key works while the search box is focused; Ctrl+Tab switches modes from anywhere.
settingsHistoryCapHint: Pinned entries do not count toward this limit.
settingsClipIgnorePickerHint: Choose a running app or type a process name manually.
settingsClipboardPluginHint: Disabling the clipboard page does not stop background clipboard capture. Turn off recording options on the Clipboard settings page to stop collecting history.
settingsPathNotDir: The path is not a folder.
settingsPathDuplicate: This folder is already in the list.
autoDelayInvalid: Enter a delay from 0 to 60000 ms.
autoAgentResidentDependency: Turn on “Use the elevation agent” to keep the helper resident.
autoTestFailed: The automation test failed. See the log for details.
pluginsTrustAllBanner: All disk plugins are trusted. Capability checks are skipped until you turn off All trust or developer mode.
pluginsActionFailed: The plugin action failed. See the log for details.
settingsIndexFilesHint: Choose whether each folder indexes files or only launchable entries.
settingsClipIgnoreInvalid: Enter an app name, for example Chrome.
settingsAppearancePageDesc: Choose Lume's interface language, theme, and settings-window skin. Changes preview instantly and save automatically.
settingsLauncherPageDesc: Control the launcher window, home content, and session behavior.
settingsClipboardPageDesc: Manage clipboard capture, display, paste, and preview behavior.
settingsSearchPageDesc: Choose the apps and files Lume indexes, and maintain the rebuildable cache.
settingsHotkeysPageDesc: Set the keys that summon Lume and switch modes, then review the keyboard map.
settingsAutomationPageDesc: Send a configured shortcut when a program's new window takes focus.
settingsPluginsPageDesc: Enable, configure, and inspect plugins. Capabilities only come from the manifest.
settingsSystemPageDesc: Manage Windows integration, background helpers, and data backups.
settingsAboutPageDesc: Version, license, contributors, and project links.
settingsLanguageHint: Changes the current window and tray menu immediately.
settingsColorModeHint: Follow Windows, or keep Lume dark or light.
settingsColorModeDetail: Follow system reacts to the Windows app mode without restarting Lume.
settingsSkinHint: Changes only this settings window; the launcher and plugin pages keep their current look.
settingsSkinDetail: Quiet Control Deck uses rounded cards and two quiet planes. Chromatic Edge uses square panels, numbered navigation, and mineral green or charcoal-blush color.
settingsSkinSaveFailed: Could not save the settings-window skin.
settingsAccentHint: Adds an accent color to selection, focus, and surfaces in this settings window.
settingsAccentDetail: Affects this settings window only. Text and focus contrast are corrected automatically; the launcher and plugin pages stay unchanged.
settingsAccentSaveFailed: Could not save the settings-window accent color.
settingsWindowPositionHint: Presets position the window on its first appearance; manual position keeps its current spot.
settingsWindowPositionDetail: Position is remembered only for this run. After a restart the configured placement is used again.
settingsShowExplorerHint: Shows folder actions while Explorer is in the foreground.
settingsExpandPinnedHint: Remembers whether the pinned bar starts expanded.
settingsModeIconsHint: The launcher also switches to icons automatically when the window gets narrow.
settingsShiftEnterHint: Starting as administrator may trigger Windows UAC.
settingsShiftEnterDetail: Shift+Enter launches the selected app elevated through Lume's separate elevation path.
settingsRememberPageHint: Returns to the last page after a restart; the search query is never written to disk.
settingsPerModeQuerySummary: Off: every mode shares the search box. On: each mode remembers its own query.
settingsIdleResetSummary: After the hidden threshold, the next summon starts clean.
settingsIdleMinutesHint: Used only while idle reset is enabled.
settingsRecentCountHint: Between 5 and 200 items; pinned entries stay exempt.
settingsPlaceholderHint: Leave empty to use the localized default placeholder.
settingsRecordImagesHint: Images are stored in the local clipboard cache.
settingsRecordFilesHint: Files are stored as references, not copied.
settingsMergeCopyHint: Consecutive text copies inside the time window become one entry.
settingsMergeWindowHint: Available when merge copies is on; range 0.5–5 seconds.
settingsHoverSelectHint: When off, only a click changes the selected entry.
settingsSystemIndexHint: Desktop, System32, and Start Menu launch entries.
settingsIndexDesktopHint: Files, shortcuts, and programs on your desktop and the public desktop.
settingsIndexSystem32Hint: Windows built-in command-line and system tools.
settingsIndexStartMenuHint: Installed apps and shortcuts in the Start Menu.
settingsCacheHint: Startup always refreshes once; this controls later background refreshes.
settingsRefreshIndexHint: Rebuilds only the rebuildable index caches.
settingsToggleHotkeyHint: The single global shortcut Lume registers at startup.
settingsSwitchHotkeyHint: A single key works while the search box is focused; Ctrl+Tab works anywhere.
settingsForceFocusSummary: Windows may refuse background focus changes; failures are logged.
settingsUseAgentSummary: Needed to reach programs running as administrator.
settingsResidentSummary: Keeps a small privileged helper in memory after logon.
settingsAutomationRulesHint: Each rule sends once when its program opens a new focused window.
settingsAgentStatusHint: Read-only status; manage registration on the System page.
settingsPluginInstallHint: Inspect a .lupx package before installing it.
settingsAutostartHint: Writes to the current user's startup entry; no administrator rights required.
settingsServiceHint: The SYSTEM index service for whole-drive file search.
settingsExportHint: Writes the complete settings file to a location you choose.
settingsImportHint: Replaces the live settings after confirmation.
settingsRestoreBackupHint: Restores the previous settings file from backup.toml.
settingsRestoreDefaultsHint: Resets appearance, launcher, clipboard, hotkeys, search, and automation only.
settingsRestoreDefaultsHintLong: This replaces appearance, launcher, clipboard, hotkey, search, and automation settings. Plugins and system integrations are not changed.
settingsSearchSuggestions: Try theme, window, shortcuts, or index.
hotkeyCheatFocus: Search → mode bar → page control → settings
pluginsSelectPrompt: Select a plugin to inspect its permissions and settings.
settingsConfirmUninstallServiceHint: Whole-drive file search stops until the service is registered and started again. Settings and plugin data are not changed.
settingsConfirmImportHint: The selected TOML file replaces the live settings after current edits are saved. Plugins and system integrations are not part of this file.
settingsConfirmRestoreBackupHint: This replaces the live settings with backup.toml. This action cannot be undone from the settings window.
hotkeyNotRegistered: This shortcut is not registered — another program may own it. Record a free combination.
settingsConfirmUninstallAgentHint: Automation rules targeting elevated programs will stop working until the agent is registered again.
pluginsConfirmUninstallHint: The plugin directory and its private files are removed. The plugin document store is kept.
pluginsConfirmTrustAllHint: Capability checks are skipped for every disk plugin until All trust or developer mode is turned off.
